reviews.comment:
Deben haber cambiado al cocinero
Volviendo de un viaje ,hoy paramos allí. No es la primera vez que lo hacemos .Pedí tarta de zapallitos ,espantosa !!!!!!!!trozos de zapallitos amargos (probablemente silvestres )hervidos ,envueltos en una masa blanda
Comí unos bocados y de solo recordarlo me provoca nauseas

(Translated by Google)
They must have changed the cook. Coming back from a trip, we stopped there today. It's not the first time we've done so. I ordered zucchini tart, and it was awful! Pieces of bitter (probably wild) boiled zucchini wrapped in a soft pastry. I ate a few bites, and just remembering it makes me nauseous.
